frozen_object: Source baseline and integration contracts; not a trained entity, approved main study or qualified runtime.

charter.change: explicit target revision; existing v1 research ledgers need separate review, not relabeling

entry_points.local-init: Private local home, bounded operator authority, pinned model metadata; no download or server launch.
entry_points.local: Explicit chat, source ingestion/search, freeze/continuation, dataset preparation, fitting, consolidation, mutation, predictive state and capsule operations. --operation-help documents request fields.
entry_points.hawking-contract: Actual inspected NR/NX/Nova checks, Bridge inventory/discovery and unqualified organ-metadata mapping.
entry_points.hawking-port: Stage an explicitly pinned local Git tree without importing/building it. No prefix means the whole tracked ordinary-file tree, not an organ-only subset.
entry_points.odyssey-charter: One program charter; source-only/plan operations never launch an experiment.

implemented.development: Verified experience allocation; bounded success/failure replay selection; candidate template consolidation; inquiry agenda; independently reviewed mutation adoption/rollback.
implemented.prediction: Small action-conditioned tanh predictive memory updated from prospectively committed, independently attested partial observations; unobserved features remain predicted.
implemented.local_data: Batched UTF-8 chunks, source/license/group/rights metadata, content-addressed history, derivative FTS5 retrieval; no truth promotion from ingestion.
implemented.local_fitting: Optional explicit local MLX LoRA subprocess with whole-group datasets, exact-text split contamination checks, pinned model/interpreter/environment versions, bounded wall and polled diagnostic/output budgets.
implemented.mutation_effect: Qualified attention values reach the workspace; qualified world representations can enter broadcast. Candidate fitting never silently deploys an adapter.
implemented.privacy: Source revocation disables known provenance-dependent reuse and future fitting; raw historical data remains. No cryptographic unlearning or at-rest encryption claim.
implemented.exchange: Frozen closed-program capsules require source rights/disclosure review, quarantined imports, local witnesses and normal independent skill qualification.
implemented.portability: Whole-organization export/restore retained; actual Hawking metadata validators mapped to the existing organ API; all relevant future capability slots permitted, no permanent partial-port cap.

hawking.adaptation: Selected pure checks, wire constants and compatibility logic adapted from inspected source; not a verbatim vendoring of the full runtime.
hawking.proposed_abi: substrate-capability-port-v1 is a Substrate-side extension contract, not an assertion that current Hawking implements it.

formats.safetensors: Numeric tensor payloads; not the complete entity semantics.
formats.organization_nr: Substrate whole-organization format remains distinct from actual Hawking NR. All source, state, runtime and asset dependencies must be inventoried.
formats.native_image: Existing closed-DAG interpreter image; not a CPU/GPU/FPGA machine-code or full-model compiler.
formats.immutable_execution: New neural or procedural learning creates a candidate descendant; qualified executable identity is not rewritten in place.

local_requirements.core: cryptography; SQLite with FTS5 for the optional local corpus
local_requirements.inference: An explicitly configured compatible local chat-completion server and real model artifacts; none are bundled or auto-started.
local_requirements.fitting: Optional learn-apple extra; fitting must run in the exact pinned interpreter and installed mlx/mlx-lm versions. Standard-library/source inspection does not install them.

boundaries: No Odyssey, tests, collection, model calls, trainer, service or container was executed for this delivery.
Personal conversations are unqualified instrument outputs, not verified learning episodes.
Replay selection is not a completed retention test or neural sleep-learning result.
The allocator, attention priors and initial dynamics are bounded mechanisms, not general semantic learning or a learned consciousness architecture.
External multimodal encoders, broad real-world apprenticeship dispatchers, deeper neural recurrence, general semantic abstraction and longitudinal effectiveness remain unfinished.
MLX fitting uses an operator-trusted local subprocess; offline library flags are not an OS network sandbox, and polled disk/log limits are not hard quotas. No hard memory guarantee.
Capability-port output identity is checked, but operation-specific output schemas still require the provider adapter. No response becomes truth or state authority automatically.
Full Hawking build/inference/compiler/device integration needs actual pinned dependency closures, provider mappings and executed independent fidelity/host qualifications.
No GUI, marketplace service, arbitrary checkpoint merger, verified unlearning or sentience determination is claimed.
